blurb: Guests experience parasailing from Keyes Marina in Holmes Beach, FL. Trips are fun and safe for all, with certified professionals providing detailed instructions. Parasailing rides last 60-90 minutes and operate year-round starting at 8 a.m. every 90 minutes until sunset.
extraNote: All gift card purchases are final and non-refundable. · Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · Your pick up location is the 63rd Street boat ramp. There is parking and restrooms in the park by the tennis courts.
